name: io.rugmunch/pry
title: Pry — Web Scraping, Browser Automation & Data Intelligence MCP
description: Self-hosted web intelligence MCP: scrape, crawl, extract, monitor, parse, screenshot, x402 pricing, plus ten data domains (crypto, marketplace, legal, real estate, jobs, travel, attention, local, gov, ip).

tools.name: pry_extract
tools.description: Extract structured JSON from a URL using CSS selectors — cheaper than LLM extraction.

tools.name: pry_template
tools.description: Execute one of 110+ pre-built scraper templates (amazon, walmart, linkedin, etc.).

tools.name: pry_search_templates

tools.name: pry_monitor

tools.name: pry_odds
tools.description: Get live betting odds across major bookmakers (DraftKings, FanDuel, BetMGM, ESPN BET, ...) for one or more sports, backed by The Odds API (free tier via PRY_ODDS_API_KEY) with an ESPN scoreboard fallback. Each record includes the event label, market, bookmaker, and decimal odds for home/away. Use to compare lines before placing a bet or to power an odds aggregator, e.g. 'what are the current NBA moneyline odds across books?' or call with sport='nfl' to see the full NFL slate.

sport.description: Sport: nba, nfl, mlb, nhl, ncaab, ncaaf, epl, mls, wnba, ufc, cfl, or 'all' (default: nba + nfl + epl)

market.description: Betting market (e.g., 'h2h' moneyline, 'spreads', 'totals'); the default feed is h2h moneyline

book.description: Bookmaker name filter (e.g., 'DraftKings', 'FanDuel', 'BetMGM'); omit for every book

event_query.description: Substring filter on event label, e.g. 'celtics'

tools.name: pry_arbitrage
tools.description: Scan sportsbook lines for guaranteed-profit arbitrage opportunities: the same event quoted at different books where the combined implied probabilities total under 100%. Use to find risk-free bets, e.g. 'show me NFL arbitrage opportunities with at least 0.8% yield' or call with sport='all' to sweep every tracked league.

sport.description: Sport: nba, nfl, mlb, nhl, ncaab, ncaaf, epl, mls, wnba, ufc, cfl, or 'all' (default)

min_yield_pct.description: Minimum guaranteed yield in percent to report (default: 0.5)

tools.name: pry_plus_ev
tools.description: Find positive expected-value (+EV) betting opportunities by comparing market odds against a sharp book's line or consensus price. Use to identify bets where the market price is better than the fair probability implies, e.g. 'what are the best +EV bets right now?' or call with sharp_book='pinnacle' and min_ev_pct=2.0 to only see edges above 2%.

sharp_book.description: Sharp book to treat as the fair line reference (e.g., 'pinnacle', 'circa', 'betonline')

min_ev_pct.description: Minimum expected value in percent to report (default: 1.0)

tools.name: pry_props
tools.description: Get player prop betting lines (points, rebounds, assists, yards, strikeouts, ...) for a player or sport, with the market and book prices. Use to research player props before betting or building a props dashboard, e.g. 'what are LeBron James points props tonight?' or call with sport='nfl' and market='passing_yards' to see QB yardage props.

sport.description: Sport: nba, nfl, mlb, nhl, ncaab, ncaaf, epl, mls, wnba, ufc, cfl, or 'all' (default)

market.description: Prop market (e.g., 'points', 'rebounds', 'passing_yards', 'strikeouts'); omit for every market

tools.name: pry_injuries
tools.description: Get the current injury report for a sport or team: player, team, injury detail, and status (out/questionable/active). Use to adjust betting models or fantasy lineups before lock, e.g. 'who is out for the Celtics tonight?' or call with sport='nfl' for the full league injury report.

sport.description: Sport: nba, nfl, mlb, nhl, ncaab, ncaaf, epl, mls, wnba, ufc, cfl, or 'all' (default)

team.description: Team name to filter by (e.g., 'Celtics', 'Chiefs'); omit for every team

tools.name: pry_live_odds
tools.description: Get live in-play odds that update during games (moneyline, spreads, totals as they move). Use for live-betting research or game-flow monitoring, e.g. 'what are the live odds for the Lakers game right now?' or call with sport='nba' and limit=50 for the current in-play slate.

sport.description: Sport: nba, nfl, mlb, nhl, ncaab, ncaaf, epl, mls, wnba, ufc, cfl, or 'all' (default)

limit.description: Maximum number of live odds records (default: 20)

tools.name: pry_scores
tools.description: Get final or live scores for one or more sports on a given day from ESPN public scoreboards (free, no quota, high-frequency safe). Use to check results or power a scores widget, e.g. 'what were the NBA scores on 20260815?' or call with sport='mlb' and date='today' for today's baseball scores.

sport.description: Sport: nba, nfl, mlb, nhl, ncaab, ncaaf, epl, mls, wnba, ufc, cfl, or 'all' (default: nba + nfl + epl)

tools.name: pry_historical_odds
tools.description: Get historical betting odds for past events (closing/open lines, best available prices) from The Odds API history feed. Use to backtest betting models or audit line movement, e.g. closing NFL moneylines for a past date.

tools.name: pry_betting_percentages
tools.description: Get public betting percentages — the share of bets and share of money on each side of a game — across bookmakers. Use to spot sharp-side steam and contrarian plays, e.g. 'how much money is on the Chiefs tonight?'.

tools.name: pry_sharp_consensus
tools.description: Get sharp consensus lines from sharp books (Pinnacle, Circa, BetOnline) with CLV estimates. Use to see where professional money is, e.g. sharp consensus for the Packers game.

tools.name: pry_alerts
tools.description: Get money-printer alerts: significant line moves, sharp steam, and CLV spikes across sports. Use to stay on top of the market without polling, e.g. list the biggest recent line moves.

tools.name: pry_weather
tools.description: Get current weather and short-range forecasts for a location (temperature, condition, humidity, wind, AQI). Use to enrich scraping jobs or model outdoor conditions, e.g. weather in Austin, TX right now.

tools.name: pry_agri
tools.description: Get agricultural data: crop conditions, growing-degree days, soil moisture, and commodity-relevant climate indices. Use to model crop yield risk or monitor growing regions, e.g. corn conditions in Iowa.

tools.name: pry_papers
tools.description: Search academic papers and preprints (arXiv, Semantic Scholar, PubMed) by keyword, author, or topic. Use for research pipelines needing scholarly grounding, e.g. recent papers on RAG.

tools.name: pry_domain
tools.description: Get a domain intelligence report: WHOIS registration, SSL/TLS details, hosting provider, and technology fingerprint. Use to enrich leads or vet domains, e.g. what can you tell me about example.com?

tools.name: pry_events

tools.name: pry_restaurant

tools.name: pry_firmographics
tools.description: Get firmographic data for a company: employee count band, revenue range, founding year, headquarters, and industry.

tools.name: pry_books
tools.description: Aggregate odds across all 112 sportsbooks (US, offshore, EU, UK, Asian), scraped directly via intelligent fallback — no paid odds API.

tools.name: pry_book_coverage
tools.description: Sportsbook coverage-registry statistics: 112 books by category, extraction method, and geo-requirement.

tools.name: pry_all_sources
tools.description: Aggregate one event's odds from every reachable source — The Odds API, ESPN, OddsPortal, Bovada, BetOnline, plus 112 sportsbooks.

tools.name: pry_actor_catalog
tools.description: List every Pry Apify Store actor (94) with description, pricing events and per-event USD price. Store parity surface: anything runnable on Apify is discoverable here. Filter by optional 'domain' substring (e.g. 'monitor', 'crypto', 'seo').

tools.name: pry_actor_run
tools.description: Run any Pry Apify actor's pipeline locally over URLs - same PPEScraperRunner + processor code path as the deployed store actors. Use after pry_actor_catalog: pass the actor name plus target urls; results are the same dataset items the Apify run would produce. Examples: actor='news-feed-monitor', actor='universal-scraper', actor='token-safety-scanner'.
